name: jupyter-workspace-sync
description: Automatically sync local repository files, configure notebook working directories & sys.path, enable %autoreload 2, and bridge CLI coding agents with remote Jupyter / Kubeflow / GKE GPU & TPU servers.

commands.title: Jupyter Sync: Clean & Full Re-sync Remote Repository
Jupyter Sync: Show Sync Output Logs
Jupyter Sync: Install 'jupyter-sync' CLI to PATH

jupyterSync.autoSyncOnSave.description: Automatically sync modified, created, renamed, and deleted files to the remote Jupyter server.

jupyterSync.enableAutoreload.description: Automatically configure IPython %autoreload 2 on remote Jupyter kernels so local .py edits take effect without restarting the kernel.

jupyterSync.setKernelWorkingDirectory.description: Automatically set the remote kernel's working directory (os.chdir) and sys.path to match the open notebook's directory and repository root.

jupyterSync.enableAgentBridge.description: Enable the local Unix socket IPC bridge (~/.jupyter-sync/) so CLI coding agents (jetski-cli) can flush syncs, inspect live cell outputs, and execute code on the remote kernel.

jupyterSync.autoSaveOutputs.description: Automatically persist updated cell outputs to the local .ipynb file after remote cell execution so local CLI tools and agents see fresh outputs and tracebacks.

jupyterSync.overwriteNotebooks.description: When false, .ipynb files are seeded only if missing on the remote server and ignored during continuous watch so running remote notebook outputs are protected.

jupyterSync.remoteBaseDir.description: Target subdirectory under the Jupyter Server root (set to empty string "" to sync directly into the server root).

jupyterSync.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from synchronization.

jupyterSync.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum individual file size (in MB) to include in automatic sync.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-git-tag-version -o jupyter-workspace-sync.vsix
